text: The rajasthan regulation of boating act, 1956 Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 195626 Act Number: 26 Enactment Date: 1956-09-10 Act Year: 1956 Short Title: The rajasthan regulation of boating act, 1956 Long Title: An Act to regulate boating in rivers and lakes in the State of Rajasthan. Whereas in the interests of the general public it is expedient to regulate boating in rivers and lakes of Rajasthan, in order to ensure the safety of the passengers and the proper running of boats.
